classification.difficultyReason: Recognise a diameter and apply the angle in a semicircle and triangle angle sum in two triangles.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: An inscribed quadrilateral with a diagonal from the lower-left vertex to the upper-right vertex through centre O. The two angles at the lower-left vertex are 63° and y; the two at the upper-right vertex are x and 28°. Ordinary source colours are replaced with black under house style.
spec.mathematics: The diagonal through O is a diameter. Each of the two triangles has a right angle at its other circumference vertex. The coordinate angles preserve the given 63° and 28° sectors.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens 63° and 28°, centre O and unknown labels x and y are visible. Printed teacher answers are omitted.

answer.worked:
The diagonal through $O$ is a diameter, so the angle at the third vertex of each triangle is $90^\circ$ (angle in a semicircle).
$$\begin{aligned}x+63^\circ+90^\circ&=180^\circ\\x&=27^\circ\\y+28^\circ+90^\circ&=180^\circ\\y&=62^\circ\end{aligned}$$
